{{softredirect|Penny}} {{spoilers}} [[File:Cassiopeia phone sprite.png|thumb|80px|Phone sprite]] '''Cassiopeia''' (Japanese: '''{{j| カシオペア}}''' ''Cassiopeia'') is a character in the ★ Starfall Street ★ story in [[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]]. They recruit the {{player}} into Operation Starfall. For most of the game, they are unseen and only communicate with the player via their [[Rotom Phone]]. ==In the core series games== ===[[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]]=== ====★ Starfall Street ★==== Cassiopeia first interacts with the player in [[Naranja Academy]]'s{{sup/9|S}}/[[Uva Academy]]'s{{sup/9|V}} cafeteria through their [[Rotom Phone]], having hacked it in order to reach them. They recruit the player into their mission, Operation Starfall, which is to bring down [[Team Star]] by defeating its five squad bosses, scattered around [[Paldea]] in their respective bases, and their "big boss" who founded the team. When the player is close to a base, Cassiopeia will call and brief them on the base and its squad boss. Once the player has defeated the squad boss, Cassiopeia will call again and reward the player with [[League Point]]s and an increased variety of [[TM]]s in the [[TM Machine]]. Cassiopeia also summons [[Penny]] of Operation Starfall's supply unit to give the player a bonus reward, which is a lot of [[TM Material|Pokémon materials]]. [[Clavell|Clive]] gives the player their bonus reward instead of Penny after the player has defeated their fifth base. The player is rewarded with increasing quantities of LP after defeating each squad boss for the first time. * '''5,000''' for defeating one squad boss. * '''6,000''' for defeating two squad bosses. * '''7,000''' for defeating three squad bosses. * '''10,000''' for defeating four squad bosses. * '''20,000''' for defeating five squad bosses. After defeating all the squad bosses, Cassiopeia reveals that they were the "big boss" and tells the player to meet them at the schoolyard of Naranja Academy{{sup/9|S}}/Uva Academy{{sup/9|V}} after dark, where their true identity is revealed. ==Quotes== {{main|Cassiopeia/Quotes}} ==In the manga== [[File:Old Roto Cassiopeia.png|thumb|170px|Cassiopeia speaking through [[Old Roto]] in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Cassiopeia debuted in ''[[PASV02|Discover! The Quaking Earth Titan!!]]''. They were first seen speaking to {{adv|Scarlet}}, congratulating her for successfully enrolling in [[Uva Academy]]. Their conversation was interrupted by [[Nemona]], who was hoping to challenge Scarlet to a battle. In ''[[PASV04|Raid! The Dark Crew Base!!]]'', Cassiopeia contacted {{adv|Violet}} by hacking into his [[Rotom Phone]], [[Old Roto]]. Violet and [[Arven]] were recruited as members of Operation Starfall, a plan to defeat the five squad bosses of [[Team Star]], forcing the group to disband. Days later, Cassiopeia and the others arrived at the [[Segin Squad's Base]], only to be approached by [[Clavell]]. Disguised as a student named Clive, Clavell asked to join Operation Starfall as well, which Cassiopeia accepted. Inside the base, Violet battled the Segin Squad's boss, [[Giacomo]], and won. Accepting his defeat, Giacomo stepped down as boss before revealing that Team Star was waiting for their true leader, the "big boss", to return. In ''[[PASV06|Skillful! The Mysterious Treasure Hunter!!]]'', it was revealed that Cassiopeia had previously tried to recruit Scarlet for Operation Starfall, but she had demanded to be granted access to Uva Academy before she'd even agree to listen to Cassiopeia's request. Although Cassiopeia had successfully falsified Scarlet's records to make her seem like an exchange student and thus granted her entrance to the academy, she still refused to help them out, having only agreed to listen to their request, not to accept it. In [[PASV15]], Cassiopeia contacted Violet and Arven to inform them about rumors of Team Star looking for a bodyguard to protect them against would-be raiders. To prevent this from happening, Violet went ahead to challenge the [[Schedar Squad's Base]] before they could find a suitable candidate. In [[PASV18]], Cassiopeia asked Violet, Scarlet, Arven, and [[Nemona]] to raid the [[Navi Squad's Base]] immediately. Cassiopeia explained that a rogue faction of Grunts came up with a plan to raid the remaining bases themselves and take over Team Star. This would allow them to change the rules about stepping down when defeated, making further raids pointless. Violet and Arven wanted to go after the Quaking Earth {{pkmn2|Titan}}, so Nemona chose to go with Scarlet and raid the base in their place. {{-}} ==In the TCG== {{main|Cassiopeia (Shrouded Fable 56)}} '''Cassiopeia''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Night Wanderer}} expansion before debuting in the English {{TCG|Shrouded Fable}} expansion, with artwork by [[Atsushi Furusawa]]. An {{TCG|ultra rare}} version with artwork by the same illustrator and a {{TCG|special illustration rare}} version with artwork by [[burari]] were released in the same sets. This card, which can only be used if it is the last card in the player's hand, lets the player search their deck for any 2 cards and put them into their hand. ==Trivia== * Cassiopeia is the only Team Star boss who does not use a [[Starmobile]] during their first battle. * Cassiopeia shares their name in French with {{tc|Gym Challenger}} Pia, a possible opponent in [[Wyndon Stadium/Champion tournaments|Wyndon Stadium Champion tournaments]] in {{g|Sword and Shield}}. * Each of Team Star's five squads is named after a star in the {{wp|Cassiopeia (constellation)|Cassiopeia constellation}}, foreshadowing Cassiopeia's status as the team's "big boss".
